operating_notes.text: Patalganga site completed MFDS Korea FDA inspection successfully with zero observations.
FY26 capex of ₹59.06 Cr took gross block up, with capital work-in-progress at ₹25.42 Cr at Mar-2026.
The company has two USFDA-approved plants, at Tanuku (Andhra Pradesh) and Patalganga (Maharashtra).
FY26 net tax was a ₹6.33 Cr credit, including a ₹5.52 Cr deferred-tax write-off on moving to the new tax regime from FY27.
Received 9 No DMF Deficiency letters from USFDA for Metformin HCl during July-August 2026.
Patalganga facility received National Safety Council Certificate of Excellence for the third consecutive year.

predictions.kpi: FY27 EBITDA margin holding near FY26's 16.42%

timeline.summary: Wanbury announced successful completion of the MFDS Korea FDA inspection at its Patalganga facility with zero observations on April 28, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹164.58 Cr (-4.3% YoY), net profit ₹21.7 Cr (+7.1% YoY).
Wanbury Limited’s **Jitendra J. Gandhi** scheduled a physical investor/analyst group meeting and plant visit on **June 5, 2026**, covering past results and public-domain company updates.
Wanbury announced receiving 9 USFDA No DMF Deficiency letters for Metformin HCl and expanding its business in Saudi Arabia and Mexico.
Wanbury's Tanuku and Patalganga facilities won awards for employee practices and safety performance.
